review_basis: §42.2, deterministic details delivered before revised counts
label_definition: reuse byte-bound v3 direct/propagated experimental labels and supplemental TAS/IC without revision
candidate_rule: v3 >=50 universe positives, <=20% of experimental-aspect annotated genes, protein binding excluded
clustering_scope: within each aspect and eligibility mode on propagated gene sets in the fixed evaluation universe
initial_node_order: lexicographically sorted GO IDs; zero-based node IDs
pair_distance: binary64 (union_count - intersection_count) / union_count, equal to real-valued 1-Jaccard
average_linkage_update: (left_member_count * left_distance + right_member_count * right_distance) / (left_member_count + right_member_count), binary64 operations in this order
merge_rule: global minimum distance; exact binary64 ties resolve by smallest active node-ID pair
parent_node_rule: new node IDs increase from initial term count after every merge
cut_rule: merge if distance <= declared cutoff; no epsilon
fallback_rule: if any aspect's slots are unfilled, rerun all aspects from scratch at the next step; retain counts/skips/shortages of each attempted step; stop at first complete step; no mixing or further fallback
representative_rule: largest propagated positive set, then lexicographically smallest GO ID
tertile_rule: representatives sorted by (positive count, GO ID), split into three equal-count rank groups; remainder to small then middle
cluster_selection_rank: decreasing cluster-member count, then lexicographically smallest cluster member
development_selection: take the quota in each tertile in small/middle/large order, independently in aspect order
final_selection: take unused clusters in cluster-selection rank until aspect quota, skipping and logging representatives that are ancestors or descendants of development representatives
hierarchy_scope: same-aspect, between selected representatives, not inferred edges
metric_scope: >=5 fold support permits a pooled panel proposal; separately reported fold or biotype AP still requires >=25 positives in that domain
primary_scoring_panel_choice: pending supported-panel review; strict proposal retained to honor the standing per-fold gate
